text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects and portfolio role, not cling to it just because I bought it at a higher price.","These few months show that account values can fluctuate, but the price changes do not predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting impulsively to short-term moves.","I should keep diversification and risk in mind, and make deliberate decisions rather than trading frequently just to feel in control."]}
